tasks.name: Record supplier invoice in tracker
tasks.summary: The task records supplier invoice details in the invoice tracker to support accounts payable monitoring. The user copies the invoice number, vendor name, and invoice total from the invoice file and pastes them into the tracker, then enters the due date and the column E value.
inputs: Supplier invoice file in text editor
outputs: Updated invoice tracker with new invoice entry
decision_points: Determine the correct due date to enter for the invoice
Determine the appropriate value to enter in column E
reasons: 8 values copied by hand from one application to another

assumptions: INV-*.txt files have consistent labels or delimiters for invoice number, vendor name and total so regex or split parsing will work; to be confirmed on sample files

Excel AP Tracker column mapping is stable (A=invoice number, B=vendor, C=total, D=due date/manual 10-char value, E=copy of source value) and file lives on SharePoint/OneDrive or fixed path accessible to Power Automate
Column E is intended to equal a value already in the Notepad file and is not independent judgement; to be confirmed

Due date and Column D 10-char typed value derivation is not invented - requires business/IT to confirm if fixed rule (e.g., invoice date + terms), lookup, or human judgement; stays manual until confirmed
No Notepad API is assumed - ask vendor/IT to confirm; automation uses direct .txt file read plus Power Automate Desktop, not screen scraping where possible
AP Tracker is an Excel Table with no concurrent-lock conflict and invoice numbers are expected to be unique

automation_sketch.code:
TRIGGER: Power Automate cloud flow - Scheduled (daily) OR When files added to SharePoint folder / Desktop flow - monitor folder C:\Invoices\INV-*.txt
ACTION 1: List files in folder (Get files in folder) -> %Files%
ACTION 2: Excel - Open AP Tracker from SharePoint/OneDrive (Launch Excel / Excel Online Business - Get tables)
LOOP 3: For each %File% in %Files%:
  3.1: Read text from file %File% -> %Text%
  3.2: Parse text - Text actions: Extract with regex InvoiceNo: `INV-\d+`, Vendor: `Vendor:\s*(.+)`, Total: `Total:?\s*([0-9.,]+)` -> %InvNo%, %Vendor%, %Total%
  3.3: Validate - If %InvNo% is empty OR %Vendor% is empty OR %Total% not numeric -> Move %File% to \Exceptions\ and Continue
  3.4: Excel - Check duplicate: Lookup %InvNo% in AP Tracker Column A (Find / Filter). If found -> log duplicate and Continue
  3.5: Excel - Add a row into table AP_Tracker: ColumnA=%InvNo%, ColumnB=%Vendor%, ColumnC=%Total%, ColumnE=%Total% (copy, do NOT re-type), leave ColumnD/DueDate blank for rule/manual step
  3.6: Move %File% to \Processed\%InvNo%.txt and log to run history
END LOOP
ACTION 4: Save and Close Excel, send Teams/Email summary: processed count, exceptions, duplicates
MANUAL GATE 5: Operator fills Due Date and Column D only for new rows via dropdown/date validation, then marks Reviewed
automation_sketch.description: Power Automate batch flow that reads all INV-*.txt files, parses 3 fields with regex, duplicate-checks and appends to AP Tracker Table in one Excel write per invoice, leaving due date/Column D for validated manual entry.

bottlenecks: Write in Excel bottleneck 0.62 min per item - pasting, cell navigation, Paste in B2 + Esc correction and manual typing dominate 0.7 min/item
Transportation waste: 4 values per item carried Notepad -> Excel by copy-paste with 5 window switches and 15 switches total across 3 runs
Over-processing: Column E re-typed by hand though fingerprint proves it already exists in Notepad file
Defects/rework loop: run 1 B2 written twice (correction), run 3 Column E mismatch vs source file (wrong-item/duplicate risk)
quick_wins: Stop re-typing Column E immediately - copy-paste or =C2 formula until automation live; eliminates proven over-processing and run 3 mismatch
Keep Notepad and Excel side-by-side and use next empty row Table (Ctrl+T) to avoid Select next cell + B2 double-write and Esc churn
Add COUNTIF + conditional formatting on invoice-number Column A for instant duplicate/wrong-row poka-yoke
Batch the work: validate all 3+ invoices first, then enter in one Excel session instead of one-item-at-a-time switching

recommendations.how: Monitor folder for INV-*.txt. For each file use Power Automate Desktop Read text from file + Parse text with regex to extract invoice number, vendor name and total. Use Microsoft 365 Excel connector (Microsoft Graph Excel API) Add a row into table on AP Tracker on SharePoint/OneDrive to write columns A/B/C and set Column E = parsed source value in the same call; loop all files with zero window switching.
recommendations.title: Batch parse INV txt files and append to AP Tracker in one write
recommendations.why: Theory of Constraints on Write in Excel bottleneck (0.62 min/item) + ECRS Automate; removes 4 copy-pastes, 5 switches per item and B2 double-write / Paste+Esc waste evidenced in runs 1-3.

recommendations.how: Change SOP: never re-type Column E, always copy from source or use =C2 formula. Add COUNTIF duplicate check on invoice-number Column A and require validation of parsed values before batch submit; exceptions go to manual queue for a person.
recommendations.title: Eliminate Column E re-typing with copy + duplicate check
recommendations.why: ECRS Eliminate + poka-yoke; recording proves Column E already exists in Notepad file yet was typed, and run 3 fingerprint mismatch plus run 1 B2 corrected write show defect risk.

recommendations.how: Replace free typing with Excel Data Validation: due date via date-picker plus formula InvoiceDate+Terms where business confirms terms, otherwise lookup. Convert Column D 10-char free type to dropdown/formula/lookup once rule is confirmed; lock automation-written columns A-C/E.
recommendations.title: Replace free-typed due date and Column D with rules and validation
recommendations.why: ECRS Simplify + poka-yoke; open question on Column D source means it must stay manual until rule confirmed, free typing is over-processing and error-prone.

recommendations.how: Keep AP Tracker as Excel Table on SharePoint; build Power BI report on row count, missing due dates, duplicate invoice numbers and total variance. Schedule daily Power Automate reminder for due/overdue invoices and review defects weekly.
recommendations.title: Add batch validation and Power BI control for AP Tracker
recommendations.why: Control plan + ECRS Rearrange (validate every item first, then submit in one batch); catches wrong-item entries like run 3 and supports accounts payable monitoring purpose.

risks: Fragile parsing if INV-*.txt layout varies by supplier - needs regex testing and exception folder, otherwise wrong vendor/total
Wrong-row overwrite risk from B2/paste pattern and duplicate invoice numbers - must add duplicate lookup before Add row
Automating Column D or due date before business confirms rule would encode wrong judgement - keep manual with validation until confirmed
Excel file lock / concurrent edits on shared AP Tracker - use SharePoint Table + single batch write and Power BI monitoring, not parallel RPA writers
